---
name: Bug report
about: Something in Nucleus does not work the way the README says it should.
labels: bug
---

**What happened?**
A clear, short description of the failure. What did you expect instead?

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Download / run ... (installer version, portable ZIP, or a checkout — say which)
2. Click ...
3. ...

**Where does it fail?**
- [ ] Launcher window (Open / Stop / Install / Update / Remove)
- [ ] An installed app (PDF Workbench, Notes)
- [ ] CLI (`npm run nucleus -- ...` or `nucleus-launcher.exe --list`)
- [ ] MCP server (`npm run mcp` / `npm run mcp:federation`)
- [ ] Building the project (`npm run verify`, `cargo test`)

**Environment**
- Windows version:
- How did you get Nucleus?  (please include the version)
- Do you have Node.js on PATH?  (`node --version`)

**Logs / screenshots**
The launcher keeps a live log in its footer — paste the relevant lines here.
Screenshots welcome.
